title: Mary Golda Ross at Lockheed's Skunk Works
summary: Mary Golda Ross, great-granddaughter of Cherokee Chief John Ross, was one of 40 founding engineers of the secret Skunk Works and worked on the Agena rocket.
why: An early Native American woman engineer of the space age.

unsung.contribution: Helped found Lockheed's Skunk Works and worked on Agena rocket design.
unsung.recognition: Most specifics of her work are still classified; national tribute came a decade after her death, on a 2019 coin.
